players.name: Steve Potts
players.note: Versatile West Ham defender; played centre-back despite his size and also at right-back.

players.name: Ian Nolan
players.note: Full-back for Sheffield Wednesday on both flanks, more often the left.

players.note: Wigan utility man: mostly centre-back, but used in central midfield and pushed forward often enough to score three or four a season.

players.name: Kieron Dyer
players.note: Newcastle used him wide on the right and in central midfield in 1999/00.

players.name: Dan Petrescu
players.note: Right wing-back in Chelsea's back three.

players.name: Peter Beardsley
players.note: Second striker dropping into the hole.

players.note: FBref records him DF-first in each of these seasons, which is wrong for all of them: at Liverpool he was a striker in 2006/07 and then a hard-running right-sided forward, never a defender.
